text: Oh, well now...
zh: 哦，瞧瞧……

text: Who do we have here?
zh: 这是谁来了？

text: It has been a long time since the last visit.
zh: 距离上一次有访客，已经过去很久了。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: What are you?
zh: 你是什么存在？

text: Where am I?
zh: 我这是在哪里？

text: Do you know about the Champion's Coin?
zh: 你知道冠军硬币吗？

text: Hmm... my name?
zh: 唔……我的名字？

text:
The last time I was called...
#:Nuveyar:#. Does that answer your question?
zh:
上一次，人们称我为……
#:努维亚:#。这个回答能让你满意吗？

text: A good question indeed.
zh: 确实是个好问题。

text: However, it is not one I can answer, as I do not know. I was never given a reason for my existence.
zh: 但我无法回答，因为我也不知道。从没有谁告诉过我存在的理由。

text: Ever since the very first day, I merely watched the events around me, but never wanted to interfere.
zh: 自最初的那一天起，我只是注视着周遭发生的一切，从不愿插手干预。

text: To me, I find it more entertaining to watch.
zh: 对我而言，旁观更有乐趣。

text: To answer your question, I might call myself a mere... #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Watcher#text.default#.
zh: 要回答你的问题的话，我或许可以自称为一个……#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#观察者#text.default#。

text: We are in no specific place in no specific time.
zh: 我们不在任何特定的地方，也不在任何特定的时间。

text: I call it the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Eternal Realm#text.default#, as time and place are not even concepts here.
zh: 我称之为#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#永恒之境#text.default#，因为时间与空间在这里根本不成概念。

text: Hmm...
Was only a matter of time before this was asked.
zh: 迟早会有人问起这个。

text: Yes, I do know about the Champion's Coin.
zh: 是的，我知道冠军硬币。

text: But, a question from me, before I answer yours.
zh: 不过在回答之前，我要先问你一个问题。

text: What do #text.frames=4#you#text.default# know about the Pale Coins?
zh: #text.frames=4#你#text.default#对苍白硬币了解多少？

text: Nothing.
zh: 一无所知。

text: Expected.
zh: 意料之中。

text: If you seek to know about them, then I shall oblige.
zh: 你若想了解它们，我自当奉告。

text: I'd like to learn about the Pale Coins.
zh: 我想了解苍白硬币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Very well.
zh: 很好。

text: As you wish.
zh: 如你所愿。

text: A long time ago, as I was watching the events in your world, creatures unknown to me emerged.
zh: 很久以前，当我注视着你们世界中的种种变迁时，一些我从未见过的生灵出现了。

text: They introduced themselves as the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Pale Ones#text.default#.
zh: 他们自称为#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#苍白者#text.default#。

text: Soon after their arrival, they created artefacts of power.
zh: 他们到来后不久，便造出了蕴含力量的神器。

text: Your kind called them the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Pale Coins#text.default#.
zh: 你们的族类称之为#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#苍白硬币#text.default#。

text: The Pale Coins contained immense power, which they passed on to the owner of the coin.
zh: 苍白硬币蕴藏着无穷的力量，并会将这力量传给硬币的持有者。

text: It did not take long for your kind to fight over them, resulting in wars and chaos.
zh: 没过多久，你们的族类便开始为之争斗，战乱与混沌随之而来。

text: Soon after their appearance, the Pale Ones disappeared, not leaving a single trace, except the coins.
zh: 现身后不久，苍白者便消失了，没有留下一丝痕迹，只余下那些硬币。

text: The Pale Coins were seen as a danger to many of you, so they decided to destroy them. Admittedly, against the will of others.
zh: 在你们许多人眼中，苍白硬币是一种祸患，于是他们决定将其销毁。诚然，这违背了另一些人的意愿。

text: As time passed, more and more Pale Coins were destroyed. With every next generation, their existence faded.
zh: 随着时间流逝，越来越多的苍白硬币被销毁。一代又一代过去，它们的存在也渐渐被淡忘。

text: What about the Champion's Coin?
zh: 那冠军硬币呢？

text: Among the Pale Coins was one remarkable one. The very first Pale Coin, the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Champion's Coin#text.default#.
zh: 在苍白硬币之中，有一枚非同寻常。那就是最初的苍白硬币——#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#冠军硬币#text.default#。

text: It contained a power too great for anyone to handle, so the coin decided to grant it's power in a different form.
zh: 它蕴含的力量过于强大，无人能够驾驭，于是这枚硬币决定以另一种形式赐予它的力量。

text: The owner was able to wish for anything they wanted.
zh: 它的持有者可以许下任何愿望。

text:
Which leads me to ask.
Why are #text.frames=4#you#text.default# looking for it?
zh:
这便引出了我的问题。
#text.frames=4#你#text.default#为何要寻找它？

text: I was given a task to find it.
zh: 有人交给我寻找它的任务。

text: I want it for myself.
zh: 我想将它据为己有。

text: I don't know.
zh: 我不知道。

text: Hm, fascinating.
zh: 唔，有意思。

text: The Champion's Coin will hold whatever it is you seek from it.
zh: 你想从冠军硬币那里得到什么，它便会为你呈现什么。

text: Your indecision is interesting.
zh: 你的犹疑不定倒是很有趣。

text: Is there anything else you want to know?
zh: 你还有什么想知道的吗？

text: I want to identify a Pale Coin.
zh: 我想鉴定一枚苍白硬币。

text: Surrender my memories (New Game+)
zh: 交出我的记忆（新游戏+）

text: Surrender my memories (Choose difficulty)
zh: 交出我的记忆（选择难度）

text: Where can I find Dhul'oq?
zh: 我在哪里能找到杜尔奥克？

text: How do I leave this place?
zh: 我要怎么离开这个地方？

text: I heard about "our father".
zh: 我听说了“我们的父神”的事。

text: I know where to find Dhul'oq.
zh: 我知道去哪里找杜尔奥克了。

text: Where can I find the sacred stones?
zh: 我在哪里能找到那些圣石？

text: I found a Pale Essence.
zh: 我找到了一份苍白精华。

text: There is nothing else I want to know.
zh: 没有别的想知道的了。

text: The Seeker of the Champion's Coin.
zh: 冠军硬币的寻觅者。

text: How may I help you?
zh: 我能为你做些什么？

text: A question where the answer is as good as none, I am afraid.
zh: 恐怕这个问题的答案，说了也等于没说。

text: The Champion's Coin lies deep within the city of #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Dhul'oq#text.default#.
zh: 冠军硬币深藏于#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#杜尔奥克#text.default#城之中。

text: However, the place is not known to any of your kind.
zh: 然而，你们的族类无人知晓那地方的所在。

text: Where is the entertainment in telling you everything?
zh: 若是把一切都告诉你，乐趣何在？

text: I am sure you will be able to find the city on your own.
zh: 我相信你能靠自己找到那座城。

text: Keep an eye out for the fragments of long past generations.
zh: 留意那些远古世代残留的碎片吧。

text: Ancient knowledge holds answers to present and future.
zh: 古老的知识蕴藏着关于当下与未来的答案。

text: The same way you entered the realm, I suppose.
zh: 我想，就沿着你进入此境的方式原路返回吧。

text: You were teleported here by the power of a ritual stone. Why not give it another try?
zh: 你是借助仪式石的力量传送到这里的。何不再试一次？

text: Good luck with your search, Seeker.
zh: 祝你搜寻顺利，寻觅者。

text: Before I forget.
zh: 趁我还没忘。

text: Take this Ritual Key. With its help, you should be able to control the ritual stones and teleport wherever you wish.
zh: 收下这把仪式钥匙。借助它，你应该能操控各处的仪式石，随心传送。

text: Unless you have not activated the ritual stone yet. Then, the location will be unreachable for you.
zh: 除非你尚未激活那处的仪式石。那样的话，那个地点对你来说就无法抵达。

text: Usually, these stones will activate as soon as you interact with them. You will need the Ritual Key, however.
zh: 通常，这些石头会在你与之接触时立即激活。不过你需要仪式钥匙才行。

text: As you wish.
zh: 如你所愿。

text: Use your Ritual Key you already own to teleport between Ritual Stones.
zh: 使用你已经拥有的仪式钥匙，即可在仪式石之间传送。

text: Where can I find the Champion's Coin?
zh: 我在哪里能找到冠军硬币？

text: Yes, yes... You people always want to believe in something higher when you can't explain things to yourself.
zh: 是啊，是啊……你们这些人一旦无法解释事物，就总想去相信某种更高的存在。

text: Is there something higher?
zh: 真的有更高的存在吗？

text: I heard enough.
zh: 我听够了。

text:
Sure.
Do you want to know something else?
zh:
当然。
你还想知道些别的吗？

text: Well... how did you get back to the mortal world?
zh: 呵……那你是怎么回到凡人世界的？

text: Even if you don't necessarily worship the same thing, there will always be higher beings.
zh: 即便你们崇拜的未必是同一种事物，更高的存在也永远都在。

text:
Of course you do.
The keeper told you, didn't he?
zh:
你当然知道。
是那位守护者告诉你的，对吧？

text: And yet you are here and not in floating city.
zh: 可你如今在这里，而不是在浮空城中。

text: Nayryth, Ferumor and Erylding...
zh: 奈里斯、费鲁莫尔和埃里尔丁……

text: The stones to activate the portal to the city of Dhul'oq, right?
zh: 用来激活通往杜尔奥克城传送门的圣石，对吧？

text: Ages ago they were given to former lords to keep them safe.
zh: 很久以前，它们被交给昔日的领主们保管。

text: Anyway, what else do you want to know?
zh: 好了，你还想知道什么？

text: They failed as the sacred stones influenced the lords and their people.
zh: 他们失败了，因为圣石影响了领主与其子民。

text: You should find notes about the stones in the Tower of Dhul'oq - or the lake tower, as you might call it.
zh: 你应该能在杜尔奥克之塔——也就是你们所说的湖畔之塔——找到关于圣石的记录。

text: An interesting find, for sure.
zh: 确实是一件有趣的发现。

text: These essences seem to carry the same energy as a Pale Coin.
zh: 这些精华似乎与苍白硬币承载着同样的能量。

text: While they are certainly not as powerful they may be useful in other ways.
zh: 虽然它们远没有那么强大，但或许能派上别的用场。

text: I know you already found all of them.
zh: 我知道你已经找齐了它们。

text: While this certainly is an incredible feat, don't you get tired of constantly running around and completing your quests?
zh: 这固然是了不起的壮举，但你不厌倦吗？终日奔波，完成一个又一个任务？

text: Just to find the Champion's Coin for someone else?
zh: 只为替别人找到冠军硬币？

text: Just to find the Champion's Coin and possibly fulfill yourself a wish?
zh: 只为找到冠军硬币，或许再为自己实现一个愿望？

text: Especially, as you don't even know why you're looking for the Champion's Coin?
zh: 更何况，你甚至不知道自己为何要寻找冠军硬币？

text: But none of that matters if you won't make it past your final challenge.
zh: 但如果你过不了最后的考验，这一切都无关紧要。

text: A final challenge?
zh: 最后的考验？

text: That's enough. I have a coin to claim.
zh: 够了。我还有一枚硬币要去取。

text: Be on your way!
zh: 上路吧！

text:
Do you remember the Pale Ones?
They disappeared without a trace, just after the creation of the Pale Coins.
zh:
你还记得苍白者吗？
他们在造出苍白硬币之后，便消失得无影无踪。

text:
That is true for all of them except one.
One of the Pale Ones returned to Dhul'oq, the place where it all started.
zh:
但有一位是例外。
有一位苍白者回到了杜尔奥克，一切开始的地方。

text: Although the Pale One seems to be weakened by his wounds, he won't let you claim the Champion's Coin.
zh: 尽管那位苍白者似乎已因伤势而衰弱，他仍不会让你取走冠军硬币。

text: You have found yourself one of the Pale Coins it seems.
zh: 看来你已寻得了一枚苍白硬币。

text: Do you wish to know how to use the power of those artefacts?
zh: 你想知道如何运用这些神器的力量吗？

text: Tell me how to use the Pale Coins.
zh: 告诉我如何使用苍白硬币。

text: I already know how to use them.
zh: 我已经知道怎么用了。

text:
I see.
Is there anything else you need?
zh:
我明白了。
你还需要什么吗？

text: The coins can release their power in a variety of forms.
zh: 这些硬币可以用多种形式释放其力量。

text: Typically, the power of a Pale Coin is absorbed once you identify it.
zh: 通常来说，苍白硬币的力量会在你鉴定它时被吸收。

text: How do you know how to identify coins?
zh: 你怎么会懂得如何鉴定硬币？

text: That's all.
zh: 就这些。

text: You can even further enhance the power of the coins by absorbing other sources.
zh: 你还可以通过吸收其他来源，进一步强化硬币的力量。

text: I have been observing your world and have already seen the power of coins.
zh: 我一直在观察你们的世界，早已见识过硬币的力量。

text: While the Pale Coins may look similar to you, I recognize their true nature based on my observations.
zh: 在你们眼中这些苍白硬币或许彼此相似，而我基于长久的观察，能辨识出它们的真正本质。

text: Come to me if you want to identify a Pale Coin.
zh: 若想鉴定苍白硬币，就来找我吧。

text: Is there anything else you need?
zh: 你还需要什么吗？

text:
Very well.
Which coin do you want to identify?
zh:
很好。
你想鉴定哪一枚硬币？

text:
The Bearer of the Champion's Coin!
What can I do for you?
zh:
冠军硬币的持有者！
我能为你做些什么？

text: You finally found the Champion's Coin, did you?
zh: 你终于找到冠军硬币了，是吗？

text: And still, you were not able to claim it.
zh: 但你依然未能将它收入手中。

text: The next time you stand before your goddess, be sure your life force is fortified to endure her divine might.
zh: 下一次站在你的女神面前时，务必先巩固你的生命之力，以承受她的神威。

text: What did you wish for?
zh: 你许了什么愿？

text:
Wait!
Don't tell me.
zh:
等等！
别告诉我。

text: Sooner or later, I'll figure it out on my own.
zh: 迟早，我会自己弄明白的。

text:
Are you sure about that?
You won't be able to return here for a while.
zh:
你确定吗？
之后你会有很长一段时间无法回到这里。

text: Yes. (Choose difficulty)
zh: 是的。（选择难度）

text: No.
zh: 不。

text:
Very well!
It was nice meeting you ###player.name###.
zh:
很好！
很高兴认识你，###player.name###。

text: We already know each other, don't we?
zh: 我们已经认识了，不是吗？

text: You are the seeker of the Champion's Coin.
zh: 你是冠军硬币的寻觅者。

text: Why are you searching for the coin this time?
zh: 这一次，你又为何寻找那枚硬币？

text: So you have finally entered Varethraen.
zh: 这么说，你终于进入瓦雷斯兰了。

text:
This was a sanctuary of magic and wisdom.
Until pride led mortals to chase godhood.
zh:
这里曾是魔法与智慧的圣所。
直到傲慢驱使凡人妄图追逐神位。
